Preparing for Your Next PySpark Interview??
In today’s data-driven world, knowing PySpark is more than a skill—it's a necessity for Data Engineers and Analysts! Whether you're just starting out or have years of experience, acing PySpark interviews requires not just knowledge but real-world scenario-based answers.
We at Nitya Cloudtech have compiled some of the most commonly asked yet tricky PySpark questions to give you that extra edge! 🔥
Here are a few to get you started:
🔹 What's the difference between RDDs, DataFrames, and Datasets?
🔹 How do you optimize PySpark jobs to reduce shuffling?
🔹 What are broadcast variables, and when would you use them?
🔹 Explain the Catalyst Optimizer and its benefits.
These are not just interview questions—they are scenarios you'll face in your day-to-day work!
Want the full list of 50+ curated PySpark interview scenarios?
Check it out attachment!!
